meta.title: Franka Panda hardware: success rate vs. shaped uplink capacity
meta.source: E-5; Franka Panda (the DROID platform), two tasks (peg insertion, cluttered pick-and-place), five shaped uplink capacities, 160 trials total
meta.notes: Error bars are 95% CIs. The shaded band is where the uplink, not the policy, is the binding constraint -- its edge (bindsbelow) is what makes the 2 Mbps comparison in the caption the interesting one. The +40 pp annotation is drawn between the two curves' values at gapx.
